━━━ Residence · asks before joining ━━━
(edits message 42)
🏡 Become a resident of Korendal?

Your home moves to this city. Your properties, companies and job stay where they are, but from now on your income tax goes to the city treasury and you need a work permit to work in other cities.
You cannot move home again for 72h.
